description: This header file declares external C functions for setting and getting the Dolby audio output type within a media framework. It includes license information, include directives, and function prototypes for interacting with Dolby output modes.

methods.name: set_audio_output_type
methods.description: Sets the Dolby audio output type based on the provided enumeration value.

methods.name: get_audio_output_type
methods.description: Retrieves the current Dolby audio output type; outputs the value via a pointer parameter.
